verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the corridor as excessively wide and establishes productive use or reduction of that area as a concrete architectural-plan acceptance condition.
The client specifies a 10 cm room-wall shift to narrow the corridor, changing the spatial layout without introducing stale or conflicting attributes.
The client specifies the common-entrance partition alignment, allocation of 2.5 m² to Unit 1, and the design goal for the remaining wide entrance area.
The freelancer presents materially different entrance-area allocations and warns that one arrangement may leave inadequate separation between the three unit doors, requiring a design choice.
The client confirms construction of the Unit 1 living-room wall and corridor partition, establishing the selected spatial partition configuration.
